channel.title: The Next Step
channel.desc: The Next Step holds auditions, welcoming prospective new dancers to the studio. The new studio head makes some surprising cuts that throw the future of veteran A-Troupers into question. The fallout from auditions forces Michelle to examine her place at the studio, and make some hard decisions. Meanwhile, the arrival of a new dancer might spell trouble for Noah and Henry's friendship.
